Indeed root->discussion entry uses channel discussion, entry outbound edges allow discussion -> signals can propagate to members, so root can reach members transitively! But user says "root 与 scope-1 能到达 discussion 与 collab 入口、不能到达任何成员". Hmm in the preset design, entry uses discussion channel which also fans out to members; but the entry node with discussion.group module may consume and not forward? Actually network propagation: module processes and core propagates along edges? "模块处理完成后由核心沿边传播" — signals continue? Need understand "到达" likely means direct connectivity with specified channels/threshold, maybe an actual reachability logic considering group boundary. In Nexarbor, subnetwork/group internal? The entry's module likely forwards only to internal scope via group logic. But topological reachability could transit entry. However the requirement explicitly expects root can reach entry but not members. How can that be if entry has outbound discussion edges? Maybe because signal from root has strength and edge multipliers, no difference. Hmm.

Wait maybe "reachable" semantics used by validate/host checks considers direct business calls through groups; child member access is gated by group controller's channels. Or perhaps root's edge threshold=1 and channel discussion, then entry's module consumes signal and only its own outbound signals could go to members, but that's still reachable.

Let me check skill reference tracking reachability to understand "到达" and group semantics. Read nexarbor-basics references/lessons/11-subnodes.md and inspect-network 追踪连接与可达性.
